rule.name: SpringLockReleasedBeforeCommit
rule.message: Move the lock to a caller around the transactional call, or lock in the database with @Version or a @Lock(PESSIMISTIC_WRITE) query, instead of synchronized on this @Transactional method: the monitor is released when the method returns and the proxy commits after that, so a second thread can take the lock and still read the rows from before the commit.
